title: the recorded 2x2 clean-fraction values labelled by statistic, the corrected f_hat_ideal and the 2x2 signed-bar qualification (information)

criteria.name: I1 every cited record read unedited (no working-tree change against HEAD); sha256 recorded
I2 r_nc read from data/cf_trajectories/r_nc.json and equal to the upper end of its bootstrap interval

data.prompt: prompts/28_2x3_shot_rule_and_clean_fraction_estimator.md B4 as amended by prompts/29_cf_traj_reruling_ideal_sample_fraction.md 3(3) and Part B'
data.r_nc_caveat: r_nc is a gate-noise (A6 channel) value; on H2-2 the memory term is 5-30 % of the gate term (survey), so the composition stays gate-dominated; on IBM devices (idle dephasing) it is unknown and A5 gives the only model estimate (prompts/29 3(1))
data.label_f_hit: f_hit (reference-hit fraction): an estimator of the ideal-sample fraction f_ideal with a gate-noise bias of 1.05-1.12 (CF_traj, A6 channel) and an unknown bias under idle dephasing (CF_traj A5, both T2 ends, is the model bracket); an upper end of the fault-free fraction f_0
data.label_mixture: mixture estimate (clean_fraction_mixture): the shape statistic; at k = 4 under the A6 channel it over-estimates f_ideal by the CF_traj C7 factor

H0_model_C1_C3.criterion: C1 unscheduled Aer sample (2000 shots, seed 11): the mixture estimate of the clean accepted shots 206.3 against the reference-count estimate n_ref / p_ref = 201.5 (near-clean 105.5, garbage 16.2)
C1 scheduled Aer sample (2000 shots, seed 11): the mixture estimate of the clean accepted shots 24.0 against the reference-count estimate n_ref / p_ref = 23.8 (near-clean 30.7, garbage 18.3)
C2 the device counts carry a clean component: 6 reference-string hits over 8267 shots of 5 pubs against a garbage expectation of 2.018 (2.80 sigma; clean 4.0 shots, f_clean 6.650e-04)
C3 the T2* end of the bracket post-dicts the measured clean count: predicted 4.18 clean reference hits over 8267 shots against the measured 3.98 (echo end 197.42, ratio 49.58)

corrected.estimator: f_hat_ideal = f_hit / r_nc; interval = Garwood (hit count) and bootstrap (r_nc) combined on the log scale, each end separately

data.A5_note: Markovian Pauli model of the H0_2x2 adopted circuit (cell T3, ALAP + client XY4): depolarizing cz/sx/x from the calibration record, idle Z with probability (1 - exp(-t/T2))/2 per explicit delay; cannot represent DD refocusing of quasi-static dephasing, so the two T2 ends bracket a model number, not a device prediction
unchanged: every H0_* criterion: the same statistic on both sides of each comparison, or f-independent
the H0_kpilot NO-GO (strengthened: f_hit = 0.041 is an upper end of f_0, and f_hat_ideal is lower still)
the H0_ddtest adoption of T3: R is a ratio of hit statistics (information: DD changes the error composition, so R is not exactly the ratio of f_0 or of f_ideal)
the H0_2x2 energies (sector saturation; f-independent) and recall (1.0 from the observed per-state counts)
data.qualified: 'signed bar GO on f_pool >= 0.1' in H0_ddtest and H0_2x2 is a GO on f_hit.  On the corrected statistic f_hat_ideal = f_hit / r_nc (r_nc = 1.1151) the recorded rule (lower 95 % bound >= 0.1) reads AMBIGUOUS; the v3 rule of the 2x3 stages (lower >= 0.05 and point >= 0.10) reads GO.  The gate-noise correction is not established for ibm_kingston (idle dephasing); the A5 model bracket has r < 1 at both T2 ends, i.e. f_hit would UNDER-estimate f_ideal there.  External citations carry this qualification (owner decision 3a); no recorded verdict is edited

qualification_ruling.text:
6. **The 2x2 qualification (coordinator's question).**  A verdict is read under the rule it was preregistered
   with.  H0_2x2 was preregistered on "lower 95 % bound $\ge 0.1$" and read on $f_{\rm hit}$ (GO, recorded); on
   $\hat f_{\rm ideal} = 0.1012\ [0.0938, 0.1091]$ (`validation/CF_estimator_2x2_info.json data.adopted_2x2`) the
   recorded rule reads AMBIGUOUS — that is the qualification of owner decision 3a.  **The v3 rule (lower $\ge
   0.05$ and point $\ge 0.10$) is the rule of the 2x3 stages and does not apply retroactively to a run that was
   preregistered under a stricter rule**; applying it would be a post-hoc rule change.  External text cites:
   "signed-bar GO on $f_{\rm hit}$ under the preregistered rule; AMBIGUOUS under the conservative gate-noise
   correction $r_{\rm nc} = 1.115$; the idle-dephasing correction on ibm_kingston is unmeasured (the A5 model
   bracket has $r = 0.67$-$0.90$, i.e. $f_{\rm hit}$ would under-estimate $f_{\rm ideal}$ there)".  No verdict is
   edited; the information file gains the field `qualification_ruling` with this text.
